_note: Expected nudges per Q4 test call, written BEFORE the signal engine was run on these calls. A delivered nudge matches a label when the topic is equal and it was triggered by the labelled segment or the one after it (the recogniser can split a sentence). 'must_suppress' lists topics whose signal is expected but must NOT become a nudge (context suppression). Segment indexes follow the order of turns in data/q4/calls/*.json and evidence/audio/*.timeline.json.
